name: release-workflow
body: Release workflow: GitHub Actions workflow triggered by a human-pushed tag. It builds the four binaries, gates on native-e2e-ci, publishes assets and checksums to the GitHub Release, then updates the Homebrew formula and Scoop manifest (version, URLs, checksums) and pushes them as a manifest-only commit touching only `Formula/` and `bucket/`. It never pushes code and never creates tags.
